from pathlib import Path
import csv, hashlib, io, json, re, subprocess, sys, tomllib
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
import _psalms
ROOT = Path.cwd()
COMMIT='c2b1a271b'
rawpath=next(_psalms.CONCORDANCE_ROOT.glob(_psalms.CONCORDANCE_GLOB))
rows=list(csv.DictReader(rawpath.open(),delimiter='\t'))
# Independent oracle: expand the tracked table's equal-length rows and the two
# extents restored from the witness aliases, without calling conversion helpers.
maps={s:{} for s in ('vulgate','hebrew')}
for row in rows:
    points=[]
    for s in maps:
        low,*rest=map(int,row[s+'_verses'].split('-'))
        high=rest[0] if rest else low
        points.append([(int(row[s+'_psalm']),v) for v in range(low,high+1)])
    for a,b in zip(*points,strict=True):
        maps['vulgate'][a]=b; maps['hebrew'][b]=a
aliases=next(_psalms.CONCORDANCE_ROOT.glob(_psalms.WITNESS_ALIASES_GLOB))
for row in csv.DictReader(aliases.open(),delimiter='\t'):
    token,c,v=row['cited_locus'].split('.')
    if token!='Ps': continue
    c,v=int(c),int(v)
    hc,hv=maps['vulgate'][(c,v-1)]
    maps['vulgate'][(c,v)]=(hc,hv+1)
    maps['hebrew'][(hc,hv+1)]=(c,v)
bounds={s:{c:(min(v for ch,v in m if ch==c),max(v for ch,v in m if ch==c)) for c in range(1,151)} for s,m in maps.items()}
n=0
for s,t in [('vulgate','hebrew'),('hebrew','vulgate')]:
    for c,(low,high) in bounds[s].items():
        for first in [None,*range(low,high+1)]:
            for last in [None,*range(low if first is None else first,high+1)]:
                b={'chapter':c}; e={'chapter':c}
                if first is not None: b['verse']=first
                if last is not None: e['verse']=last
                out=_psalms.convert_range_whole('Psalms',b,e,s,t)
                expected=[maps[s][(c,v)] for v in range(low if first is None else first,(high if last is None else last)+1)]
                actual=[]
                for p in out:
                    pc=p['begin']['chapter']; plow,phigh=bounds[t][pc]
                    actual.extend((pc,v) for v in range(p['begin'].get('verse',plow),p['end'].get('verse',phigh)+1))
                assert actual==expected,(s,c,first,last,out,expected)
                n+=1
print('Exhaustive closed, whole, and half-open Psalm ranges:',n,'PASS')
base='src/sources/works/ronald-conte/catholic-public-domain-version/editions/sacredbible-original-web-2026-07-31/artifacts/'
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff-tree','--no-commit-id','--name-only','-r',COMMIT,'--',base],text=True).splitlines()
files=[f for f in files if f.endswith('.tsv') and '/verse-text-' in f]
changed=0
for name in files:
    old=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',COMMIT+'^:'+name],text=True)),delimiter='\t'))
    new=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',COMMIT+':'+name],text=True)),delimiter='\t'))
    assert len(old)==len(new)
    for idx,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(old,new,strict=True)):
        assert {k:v for k,v in a.items() if k!='text'}=={k:v for k,v in b.items() if k!='text'}
        if a==b: continue
        assert a['text'].startswith(b['text']), (name,a,b)
        removed=a['text'][len(b['text']):]
        match=re.fullmatch(r' \[ [^\]]* (\d+) \](?: \([^)]*\))?',removed)
        assert match,(name,a['chapter'],removed)
        assert idx+1<len(old) and int(match[1])==int(old[idx+1]['chapter'])==int(a['chapter'])+1,(name,a,removed)
        changed+=1
    current=Path(name).read_bytes()
    meta=tomllib.loads(Path(name).with_name('artifact.toml').read_text())
    assert hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest()==meta['sha256'] and len(current)==meta['byte_size']
print('CPDV changed rows:',changed,'across',len(files),'books; only immediate next chapter headings removed; metadata hashes/bytes PASS')

import csv, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from tools.tests.test_index_bible import index_bible, load_tool
import _psalms
propers=load_tool('mass-propers')
for s,c,t in [('vulgate',9,'hebrew'),('vulgate',113,'hebrew'),('hebrew',116,'vulgate'),('hebrew',147,'vulgate')]:
    entry={'book':'Psalms','ref':f'Psalm {c}','ranges':[{'begin':{'chapter':c},'end':{'chapter':c}}]}
    print('Synthetic',s,c,'index:',index_bible.citation(entry,s,t,propers))
    print('Shared range:',_psalms.convert_range_whole('Psalms',{'chapter':c},None,s,t))
found=[]; psalm_count=0
for cal in propers.calendars(Path('src/sources/calendars')):
    doc=propers.load_calendar(Path('src/sources/calendars'),cal)
    for _,mass in propers.masses_of(doc):
        for entry,s in propers.numbered_entries(mass,doc.get('psalm_numbering')):
            if entry.get('book')!='Psalms':continue
            psalm_count+=1
            target='hebrew' if s=='vulgate' else 'vulgate'
            try:
                expected=[p for span in entry.get('ranges',[]) for p in _psalms.convert_range_whole('Psalms',span.get('begin') or {},span.get('end'),s,target)]
            except _psalms.NumberingError:continue
            _,actual,error=index_bible.citation(entry,s,target,propers)
            if error or actual!=expected:found.append((cal,mass.get('key'),s,entry.get('ref'),error))
print('Actual appointment sweep:',psalm_count,'Psalm occurrences; index/shared conversion mismatches:',len(found),found)
chapters=defaultdict(dict)
base=Path('src/sources/works/ronald-conte/catholic-public-domain-version/editions/sacredbible-original-web-2026-07-31/artifacts')
for p in base.glob('verse-text-*/*.tsv'):
    for row in csv.DictReader(p.open(),delimiter='\t'):
        chapters[(row['book'],int(row['chapter']))][row['verse']]=row['text']
fragment_root=Path('src/sources/bibles/catholic-public-domain-version/chapters')
files=list(fragment_root.glob('*/*.json'))
assert len(files)==len(chapters),(len(files),len(chapters))
for (book,chapter),verses in chapters.items():
    j=json.loads((fragment_root/book/f'{chapter}.json').read_text())
    assert j['verses']==verses,(book,chapter)
print('CPDV all',len(chapters),'chapter fragments match the canonical verse TSVs exactly.')
